At both December 31, 2024 and 2023, the net carrying value of intangible assets was $2.0 billion.

At both December 31, 2024 and 2023, intangible assets included $1.6 billion of intangible assets associated with trade names, substantially all of which had an indefinite life and, accordingly, are not being amortized.

JPM explicitly states the net carrying values for 2024 consisted of $1.7 billion for finite-lived assets (subject to amortization) and $1.2 billion for indefinite-lived assets (not subject to amortization). Similarly, GS details a decrease in net carrying value due to specific amortization-related events (write-downs) and sales, distinguishing the active reduction from static balances.
